stated_purpose: Navigation and live traffic routing application.
evidence_source: Play Store Data Safety / App Listing
policy_text:
NaviRoute Maps Privacy Policy:

1. Location Data: We collect precise location data (GPS coordinates) to provide turn-by-turn navigation, real-time traffic alerts, and route optimization. Location collection occurs while the app is active in foreground or background navigation.
2. Audio Access: We request microphone access to enable voice search for destinations.
3. Contacts: If you opt to share your live trip ETA, we access your contacts with your permission.
4. Device Identifiers: We collect anonymous device diagnostic data to improve route quality.
